summary: This document asks IANA to deprecate three BGP path attributes: DPA, ADVERTISER, and RCID_PATH / CLUSTER_ID. They were associated with an abandoned Internet-Draft and a Historic RFC.

eli5.summary: Some old labels in the internet's routing messages are never used. This officially retires them.

subtitle: IANA marks three never-used BGP path attributes as deprecated.

tldr.problem: The IANA BGP Path Attributes registry still listed DPA, ADVERTISER and RCID_PATH / CLUSTER_ID, which came from an abandoned Internet-Draft and a Historic RFC and were never in use.
tldr.mechanism: IANA marked the registry entries for value 11 (DPA), 12 (ADVERTISER) and 13 (RCID_PATH / CLUSTER_ID) as deprecated.
tldr.outcome: CLUSTER_LIST from RFC 4456 is a different attribute and is not deprecated.

today: RFC 6938 is a Proposed Standard, and the metadata lists no RFC that obsoletes or updates it. The three attributes are marked deprecated in the IANA registry.

sections.title: Three Unused Attributes
sections.content:
The IANA BGP Path Attributes registry contains entries for DPA, ADVERTISER and RCID_PATH / CLUSTER_ID. DPA is associated with an Internet-Draft that was abandoned in 1996. The other two are associated with RFC 1863, which RFC 4223 reclassified as Historic in 2005.

The RFC states that neither specification is currently in use, nor have they ever been.
sections.eli5: Three names sat on a list for things nobody ever built. This note clears them off.

sections.title: What IANA Did
sections.content:
IANA marked three entries in the BGP Path Attributes registry as deprecated:

  • DPA, value 11
  • ADVERTISER, value 12
  • RCID_PATH / CLUSTER_ID, value 13

The deprecated CLUSTER_ID is distinct from CLUSTER_LIST in RFC 4456. CLUSTER_LIST is not being deprecated.
sections.eli5: The three entries get a note saying do not use. A similar-sounding one that is still in use stays as it was.

sections.title: Security Considerations
sections.content: The RFC says there are no meaningful security consequences arising from this registry update.
sections.eli5: Retiring unused labels does not make anything less safe.
